content.summary: Security assessment findings produced by applying agent.security_review rules to blk_auth_session_model_v1.

criteriaEvaluated.criterion: Every selected security-domain block is assessed.
criteriaEvaluated.evidence: All four failureModes in blk_auth_session_model_v1 were assessed against security block criteria.

criteriaEvaluated.criterion: Every finding references a specific block, acceptance criterion, or constraint.
criteriaEvaluated.evidence: Each finding below references a specific invariant or failureMode from blk_auth_session_model_v1.

criteriaEvaluated.criterion: No fabricated vulnerabilities — all findings traceable to block evidence.
criteriaEvaluated.evidence: All findings are grounded in block failureModes. Test coverage for cross-tenant leakage (failureMode-3) is documented but not verified by automated tests.
criteriaEvaluated.gap: No automated test asserting that a session from workspace A cannot access workspace B resources.

criteriaEvaluated.criterion: Threat surface summary derived from block failureModes.
criteriaEvaluated.evidence: Threat surface below is derived exclusively from the four failureModes declared in blk_auth_session_model_v1.

findings.finding: Cross-tenant session leakage mitigation is documented as a procedure (bind session to workspace ID) but has no corresponding automated test case.
findings.remediation: Add integration test asserting that a session for workspace A returns 403 when accessing workspace B resources.

threatSurface: Session fixation — mitigated by session ID regeneration on login.
Refresh token theft — mitigated by rotation-on-use and reuse invalidation.
Cross-tenant session leakage — procedure documented; test coverage gap identified.
Session storage failure — mitigated by fail-closed posture.
